subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should OpenClaw accept a prominent Control UI Overview row for the existing admin-scoped configPath snapshot field, move the same information to Settings, or rely on the existing CLI/config surfaces?
rationale: The source-level fix is small, but the issue is a UI placement request and the open PR still needs proof/rebase plus maintainer acceptance of exposing an absolute local path in the Overview card.

options.title: Accept the Overview row
options.body: Land the linked presentation-only change after real Control UI proof and current-main rebase confirm the active config path appears only from the existing admin-scoped snapshot field.

options.title: Move it to Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing configPath field to be surfaced in a Settings or Config information area instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI only
options.body: Close this direction as covered by the existing config command if maintainers do not want another UI exposure point for local paths.

recommendation.title: Accept the Overview row
recommendation.body: Land the linked presentation-only change after real Control UI proof and current-main rebase confirm the active config path appears only from the existing admin-scoped snapshot field.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest feature-history signal for the Overview view structure that would receive the visible row.
